name: samsung-notes-mcp
description: Let Claude read your Samsung Notes: typed text, handwriting pages, photos and PDFs such as invoices. Read-only. Unofficial.
long_description: Claude can list, search and read your Samsung Notes, see handwritten pages, and open attached photos and PDFs such as invoices and receipts. It works with Samsung Notes for Windows automatically, or with a folder of notes exported from the Samsung Notes phone app. It never changes your notes. Not affiliated with Samsung.

tools.name: notes_overview
tools.description: Where notes come from, folders, totals and problems.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List or search notes by words, folder, date, attachments or handwriting.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read a note's typed text, tables, attachments, and which pages hold handwriting.

tools.name: get_page_image
tools.description: See a page as an image, including handwriting.

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Open an attached photo or PDF, such as an invoice.

exports_dir.title: Exported notes folder (optional)
exports_dir.description: Leave empty if you use Samsung Notes for Windows. Otherwise choose a folder of .sdocx files exported from the Samsung Notes phone app (select notes → Share → Samsung Notes file).
